children: unit are in talks to join the NFL's list of approved private equity firms that can take minority stakes in its teams, people familiar with the matter told Bloomberg News.
The process will likely be completed next year, according to one of the sources, who weren't authorized to speak publicly about the talks.
The league has been in communication with several private equity firms, and the NFL's owners are pleased with its private equity partners so far, said a source familiar with the talks.
